task: Implemented auto-updating site pages (Resources, Portfolio, Panel of Experts, Pitched), added file-optional entry creation for Portfolio/Experts/Pitched via vault UI, and verified end-to-end publishing workflow with YouTube videos and portfolio companies.
discussion_summary: Session 1 built the vault file table with assignment workflows and Resources publishing. This session extended that foundation by implementing auto-refresh on public-facing pages (15-second polling + focus-triggered refresh), enabling entries without file uploads (migration 013_site_items_optional_file.sql), and adding **+ Add** buttons to Portfolio, Experts, and Pitched tiles. The vault now supports both file-based and file-optional entries; published content appears on the site within ~15 seconds without page reload. All backend tests (154/154) and frontend tests (16/16) pass; TypeScript is clean.

accomplishments.what: Implemented auto-refresh on Resources, Portfolio, Panel of Experts, and Pitched pages: 15-second polling interval with immediate refresh on tab focus
Created migration 013_site_items_optional_file.sql to make file_id nullable in site_items table, enabling entries without uploaded files
Added **+ Add** buttons to Portfolio, Experts, and Pitched tiles in vault UI; entries show initials instead of photo/logo when no file is present
Verified end-to-end YouTube video publishing: pasted URL, titled entry, published from vault, video appeared on Resources → Learn page within 15 seconds with thumbnail

Verified end-to-end Portfolio company publishing: filled name, sector, stage, website (https://example.com), description, latest update; published without file; card appeared on Portfolio page with description, stage, update, and clickable website link
Implemented remove (✕) button for file-optional entries in vault; allows deletion of entries without file uploads
Tested both Chrome tabs (vault + site) simultaneously; confirmed no console errors and proper cross-tab visibility of published content
All backend tests passing (154/154), all frontend tests passing (16/16), TypeScript compilation clean

decisions.decision: Resources has 4 fixed tabs (Understand, De-Mystify, Analyze, Learn) with per-tab validation rules (kind, category, published_on, platform) stored in resource_items table
decisions.reason: Mirrors public Resources page structure and filters; enables granular content curation; database row tracks metadata for API and frontend display

decisions.decision: Published Resources files show 'Published' tag in vault table and cannot be reassigned via normal assign workflow
decisions.reason: Prevents accidental modification of published content; makes publication status visually clear; enforces one-way publish semantics

decisions.decision: Vault file table includes checkbox column with select-all header, per-row 'Assign to…' menu, and bulk selection bar ('N selected · Assign to…')
decisions.reason: Allows users to assign multiple files at once; per-row menu enables single-file assignment; bulk bar is always rendered with visibility:hidden to prevent layout shift

decisions.decision: File assignment logic: user uploads (Inbox, category files) are moved; main-app files (applications/, project-ID folders, canvas-policy/, test/) are copied to preserve originals
decisions.reason: Protects system files from accidental deletion; user uploads are ephemeral and safe to move; preserves audit trail

decisions.decision: Public-facing pages (Resources, Portfolio, Panel of Experts, Pitched) auto-refresh every 15 seconds and immediately on tab focus
decisions.reason: Provides near-real-time visibility of published content without requiring manual page reload; balances responsiveness with server load

decisions.decision: Portfolio, Panel of Experts, and Pitched entries can be created without file uploads; entries show initials instead of photo/logo
decisions.reason: Reduces friction for adding entries; not all portfolio companies or experts have logos; file_id is nullable in site_items table

decisions.decision: Vault entries without files have remove (✕) button; entries with files use standard assignment workflow
decisions.reason: Provides clear deletion path for file-optional entries; maintains consistency with file-based entry management
